news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹6.50 (vs ₹5.25 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹6.50 (up from ₹5.25 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹1.55b (up 57% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹215.3m (up 59% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 14% (in line with FY 2025).

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk High level of non-cash earnings (22% accrual ratio). news.title: Shree Refrigerations Limited Announces Board and Executive Appointments, Effective February 23, 2026
news.body: Shree Refrigerations Limited approved the appointment of Ms. Rucha Ravalnath Shende as Additional Director (Whole Time Director Category) on the Board of the Company, effective from February 23, 2026. She shall hold office up to the date of the next Annual General Meeting or the last date on which the AGM should have been held, whichever is earlier. Ms. Rucha Ravalnath Shende is a Mechanical Engineer with a strong background in HVAC, Plumbing, and Fire Protection design. She possesses extensive experience using REVIT and AutoCAD on institutional, healthcare, laboratory, and public sector projects, with a learning-forward approach that supports project delivery and design development through construction.
